Selected 1,541,650, weighted 30% Incurred CL (1,400,893) / 70% Paid CL (1,601,975). At 59 months (Mid band) the two CL indications diverge by 13.4% — wide dispersion, investigated rather than blended evenly. Diagnostic: Incurred actual (978,900) and Paid actual (976,051) are nearly identical at this maturity, implying almost no open case reserve at ~5 years — atypical for WC, where meaningful case reserves are normally still carried at this age. This pattern is consistent with case-adequacy erosion / under-reserving on open claims (Sec 2 signal: 'case adequacy falling → dampen Incurred CL, shift weight to Paid CL'), which would cause Incurred CL (built on understated case incurred) to understate the true ultimate — supporting the tilt toward Paid CL. BF corroborates the same direction (incurred BF 1,534,253 vs paid BF 1,696,386). No prior ultimate selection available (first-time analysis) — anchoring (Sec 3.2) and asymmetric conservatism (Sec 3.3) not applicable; selection is method-based only. IELR proxy = 0.33%. Flagged for manual review: the near-zero implied case reserve at this maturity should be checked against claim-level case reserve data in the next study, as it is the key driver of the method divergence.

Selected 2,018,009, weighted 60% Incurred BF (2,133,068) / 40% Paid BF (1,845,420). At 23 months this AY sits at the Very-Green/Green boundary under the WC-shifted schedule, where the table nominally favors a priori/BF heavily. Rather than default to CL (extremely high-leverage and noisy this early, cdf 1.97-2.95, methods carry effectively zero weight per the maturity table at this age), BF is retained as the best available compromise: it incorporates actual emergence on top of the (weak) a priori and dampens CL's extreme leverage. Incurred is weighted above Paid consistent with the long-tail lead principle. No prior ultimate selection available (first-time analysis) — anchoring (Sec 3.2) and asymmetric conservatism (Sec 3.3) not applicable; selection is method-based only. IELR proxy = 0.41%. Flagged for manual review: the a-priori/Initial-Expected baseline appears stale for the recent AYs (see also 2024) and should be recalibrated with more recent experience in the next study; this reduces confidence in the selection somewhat, though it remains the most defensible available estimate.

Selected 1,282,354. At 11 months (Very Green band even after the WC tail shift; only 30.9% developed on the incurred CDF basis) CL is pure noise (cdf 3.24 incurred / 7.52 paid) and is zero-weighted per Sec 1.2/5.1. Within the BF family, Incurred BF (1,579,941) is weighted above Paid BF (1,220,349) — 70/30 — reflecting that incurred leads and paid lags severely this early for WC (only 13.3% paid-developed). That incurred-weighted BF blend (1,472,063) is then blended 60/40 with the a-priori Initial Expected (997,790, an empirical 3-yr rolling average per Sec 5.1, not a pricing ELR) to temper first-diagonal noise, giving 1,282,354. No prior ultimate selection available (first-time analysis) — anchoring (Sec 3.2) and asymmetric conservatism (Sec 3.3) not applicable; selection is method-based only. IELR proxy = 0.26%, in line with other lighter/early AYs; this is a first-diagonal estimate with the widest uncertainty band in the triangle and should be revisited materially as more experience emerges.
